title: LibreSprite 1.3 real native pixel editor successfully verified in GitHub Actions
summary: Implemented a reproducible GitHub Actions workflow that downloads the OFFICIAL LibreSprite 1.3 AppImage, extracts and launches its actual headless batch editor, executes JavaScript inside a sprite cel to change two RGBA pixels, exports a PNG and validates those exact pixels plus transparency. All steps passed on run 42961553641 with downloadable image/report artifacts. This is a VERIFIED TOOL INTEGRATION smoke test, NOT an artistic quality or game production pass. LibreSprite is ephemeral per runner; current ChatGPT sandbox does not have a local editor install. Use this workflow to build future authored layered sprite and animation tests, and keep source game art out of public repo.

reviews.evidence: GitHub Actions run 42961553641 completed success, job 130329020481: LibreSprite 1.3 binary launched, script ran in actual editor and logged edited pixels; smoke verifier confirmed pixel (16,16) changed from RGBA 48,53,69,255 to 171,91,240,255, pixel (17,16) changed to 134,72,210,255, PNG dimensions 32x32, transparent corner. Artifact 13828809383 contains input/output/report. Scope of tested status is editor integration ONLY, not artwork quality.
